intro.tail: focused on building thoughtful, people-first products.

philosophy.label: DESIGN PHILOSOPHY
paragraphs: Design starts with intention. For me, good design is about more than creating a polished interface. It starts with understanding people, the context they are in, and the problem we are trying to solve. I believe the best products don't force behaviour, but remove friction, build trust, and make complex systems feel simple and human. There is no single formula for good design; the approach should adapt to the context, but every decision should have a clear and helpful purpose.

items.title: Design is for everyone
items.body: Inclusive products meet people where they are — across ability, language, culture, and context. Accessibility and clarity are not extras; they are how thoughtful design earns trust.

items.title: Design is strategy
items.body: Every screen is a decision about what matters. I connect research insights to business goals so design choices move metrics and meaning, not just pixels.

items.title: Design is collaboration
items.body: The best outcomes come from working closely with product, engineering, support, and stakeholders. Shared understanding beats solitary perfection.

items.title: Design needs evidence
items.body: Curiosity drives the work: interviews, usability tests, data, and messy real-world feedback. Evidence keeps taste honest and iteration purposeful.

testimonials.quote: Luli is a fantastic collaborator. She led user interviews with real curiosity and developed a deep empathy for our users, which came through clearly in her designs. She was thoughtful, collaborative, and an absolute pleasure to work with.

about.heading: About
about.path: Buenos Aires → Berlin → Valencia via design

blocks.text: I've always been more curious about what happens behind the scenes than what ends up on the screen. That curiosity took me to Buenos Aires first, where I studied film and specialised in art direction. Ten years in video production, art direction and editing followed.

Then I moved to Berlin and joined a German VoD platform as a Content Manager. There, I found a new fascination with human behaviour and psychology, and with how interfaces are designed to solve real problems. Turns out I'd found my next career without meaning to.

For the past 7+ years, I've worked with German and international companies across service platforms, mobility, EdTech and marketplaces—designing products for people in Germany, Singapore and beyond. Still the same curiosity, just a different screen: understanding people, how things work, and what makes an experience feel right.
Outside of work, I love discovering new places, hosting friends for dinner, getting competitive over board games and, since moving to Valencia, playing padel.

items.description: Led product design across Customer and Partner Apps in Germany and Singapore — from complex service flows and a first design system to growth experiments that cut dispute costs and lifted conversion.
Led end-to-end product design for a multimodal mobility platform — discovery, comparison, booking, and onboarding — so people could choose smarter ways to move through the city.
Shaped learning flows and illustration for an EdTech app with 1M+ users — making language practice feel closer to reading a story than grinding flashcards.
Designed product surfaces for an interactive piano learning app, focusing on clear practice flows and motivating visual feedback for self-taught learners.
Redesigned a B2B AI platform for fashion brands — clarifying complex idea-to-production workflows so intelligent tools felt approachable and trustworthy.
Designed UX/UI for an early-stage product, turning fuzzy requirements into clear flows and approachable interfaces that supported fast iteration.
Managed content for a German VoD platform — bridging storytelling craft and digital product operations before moving fully into product design.
